Dependent targets will relink/rebuild through Cargo's normal dependency tracking.

Both failed consumers, `aa_aa` and the API library test, report undefined Rust anonymous/private or monomorphized core/HashMap symbols from the same producer archive. This differs from a missing external library symbol. The archive contains 258 members and was written at 08:16:15 UTC on 10 September. The cache's work products were therefore reused across the rebuild. The interrupted earlier attempt also left generated objects for this exact compilation unit dated 08:05–08:07 UTC.
